definitions: def modulus: nat = $ x1 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 $;
def uadd (a b: nat): nat = $ (a + b) % modulus $;
def umul (a b: nat): nat = $ (a * b) % modulus $;
def wmax: nat = $ x7 :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf :x xf $;
def wmin: nat = $ x8 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 :x x0 $;

obligations.declaration: theorem endpoint_small (a: nat): $ 3 : 5 : umul a (uadd 3 5) : 0 = 3 : 5 : umul a 8 : 0 $;

obligations.declaration: theorem endpoint_boundary (a: nat): $ wmax : 1 : umul a (uadd wmax 1) : 0 = wmax : 1 : umul a wmin : 0 $;
